fieldContext.note: INCOSE defines a system as an interacting combination of hardware, software, firmware, people, facilities, and services. Software requirements apply specifically to the software elements within that system.
fieldContext.source: INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook / SWEBOK v4.0 Section 1.9

personalNotes: In embedded/CPS systems (like autonomous vehicles or medical devices), system requirements allocate to software vs hardware. In pure SaaS software, the software IS the system of interest.
